description: Period-over-period change by query or page: clicks, impressions, CTR and position for both periods with deltas, plus property totals (which include anonymised queries). Default: the last 28 days of final data vs the 28 days before. Biggest movers first. Search Console data typically lags 2–3 days; the default range ends 3 days ago (Pacific Time). Pass data_state "all" to include fresher, still-changing data. Grouping or filtering by query omits anonymised (rare) queries, so query rows add up to less than the totals by date, country or device. Uses 4 Search Analytics queries.

compare_end_date.description: End of the earlier period. Default: the day before start_date.

compare_start_date.description: Start of the earlier period. Default: the same number of days right before start_date.

expression.description: Value to match. country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, lowercase (e.g. "pol", "usa"); device: "DESKTOP", "MOBILE" or "TABLET"; page: a full URL.

operator.description: Default "equals". Regex operators use RE2 syntax.

rows_per_period.description: How many rows (sorted by clicks) to fetch per period. Default 5,000, max 25,000. Rows beyond this are not considered.

search_type.description: Default "web". "discover" and "googleNews" don't support grouping by query or aggregation_type "byProperty".

site_url.description: Search Console property exactly as list_sites shows it: "sc-domain:example.com" for a domain property, or a URL prefix with its trailing slash, e.g. "https://www.example.com/".

name: compare_periods
title: Compare two periods
